title: Test-Strip Refill Shipments — Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program System Reference
content:
**Policy.** A strip refill on a Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program draws on the program's newest authorization grant for test strips and ships at the rate of a written order, under the refill release standard and the payer allowance policy; on tiers where refill confirmation is required the customer confirms it personally first.

**Prerequisite clauses**

1. A strip refill that takes the program's test strips shipped over the 90 days ending on its ship date, that refill counted, above the tier's strip allowance is not shipped until a liability notice for test strips, signed by the customer on or after the date of the newest written order for test strips, stands on the program's file.
2. The units of the first strip refill after a newly supplied meter are fixed only after the shipment of strips the customer holds from the latest strip refill, while its return window is open, carries a take-back authorization for any of its units counted as still sealed.

As record states: a refill that, counted with the test strips the program shipped in the 90 days ending on its ship date, comes to more than the tier's strip allowance waits until the program's file shows a liability notice for test strips signed on or after the newest strip order's date; and the units of the first refill after a newly supplied meter wait, while the held shipment's return window is open, until that shipment shows a take-back authorization for its units counted as still sealed.

## Tool: `ship_strip_refill_72890190`

**What it does.** Ships one refill package of blood glucose test strips (item A4253) on a Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program enrollment by standard ground shipping today. One call records the refill shipment on the enrollment's shipment history, drawing the given billing units from the named authorization grant, with 50 test strips per unit as the package's pieces, the supply days it covers, how it is billed and the customer's confirmation date where one was given; the enrollment's billing units still authorized to ship are reduced by the units shipped. The customer can afterwards see the package on the shipment history.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `ship_strip_refill_72890190`.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `bgm_program_id` | identifier — the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program enrollment the refill ships on, as returned by the enrollment lookup |
| `customer_id` | identifier — the customer reference number of the enrollment holder, as returned by the customer profile lookup |
| `bgm_order_id` | identifier — the authorization grant record for test strips the refill draws its units from, as returned by the prescription and authorization lookup |
| `previous_bgm_shipment_id` | identifier — the enrollment's previous test-strip refill shipment that this refill follows, as returned by the shipment-history lookup; quoted on the receipt |
| `coverage_id` | identifier — the insurance coverage record the enrollment bills, as returned by the coverage lookup; quoted on the receipt |
| `units` | integer count of whole billing units of test strips shipped (one unit is 50 strips); the pieces are recorded as 50 strips for every unit |
| `supply_days` | the days of supply the refill covers, in integer calendar days, a multiple of 30 |
| `billing_route` | `payer_claim` when the enrollment's tier bills a payer by claim; `self_pay` when the enrollment is on the self-pay tier and the units are charged to the customer at the cash price |
| `refill_confirmation` | `confirmed_today` when the customer confirmed in this contact that they still use the strips and how many they have on hand, so today's date is recorded as the confirmation date; `not_required` when the enrollment's tier ships refills without a per-shipment confirmation, so no confirmation date is recorded |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new refill shipment reference number, the ship date in YYYY-MM-DD form, the integer billing units and pieces shipped, the supply days, the billing route, the authorization grant drawn on, the previous refill and coverage reference numbers, and the billing units still authorized to ship on the enrollment afterwards. Its presence means the package shipped.
